function.name: handle_addref
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a handle_wrapper structure.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the handle_wrapper structure whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: handle_release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the handle. If the reference count reaches zero, it frees the memory allocated for the handle and, if the 'delete_on_release' flag is set, it also frees the memory allocated for the 'hglobal' field of the handle.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: A pointer to the handle_wrapper structure which encapsulates the handle whose reference count is to be decremented.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: handle_create
function.description: This function creates a new handle, allocates memory for it, sets its properties, and returns a pointer to it.

parameters.name: hglobal
parameters.description: A handle to a global memory object. If this parameter is NULL, the function allocates a new global memory object.

parameters.name: delete_on_release
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether the global memory object should be automatically deleted when the handle is released.

function.return_type: struct handle_wrapper*. It represents a pointer to the newly created handle. If the function fails to allocate memory for the handle or the global memory object, it returns NULL.

function.name: impl_from_IStream
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: struct hglobal_stream*; Represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: hglobalstream_construct
function.description: This function allocates memory for a new hglobal_stream object, initializes its fields and returns a pointer to it.
function.return_type: struct hglobal_stream pointer, representing the newly created hglobal_stream object

function.name: stream_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the requested interface ID (IID). If it does, it increases the reference count of the interface and returns a pointer to it. If it doesn't, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The requested interface ID

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the pointer to the requested interface will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface supports the requested IID, E_NOINTERFACE if it doesn't, and E_INVALIDARG if the obj parameter is NULL

function.name: stream_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the stream object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IStream interface of the stream object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the stream object after incrementing.

function.name: stream_Release
function.description: This function releases a stream and decrements the reference count. If the reference count is zero, it releases the handle and frees the stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the stream to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the stream has been released.

function.name: stream_Read
function.description: This function reads data from a stream into a buffer, updates the stream's position, and returns the number of bytes read.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream interface from which to read data.

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer into which the data is read.

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: Number of bytes to read from the stream.

parameters.name: read_len
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the actual number of bytes read.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: stream_Write
function.description: This function writes data to a stream, and if necessary, increases the size of the stream. It also locks and unlocks the global handle of the stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStream interface

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be written

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: Number of bytes to be written

parameters.name: written
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the actual number of bytes written

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, error code otherwise

function.name: stream_Seek
function.description: This function seeks to a new position in the stream based on the move and origin parameters, and updates the position.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStream interface

parameters.name: move
parameters.description: The offset to move the pointer in the stream

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin from where to move the pointer. It can be the start, current position or end of the stream

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the new position in the stream

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, otherwise it returns an error code

function.name: stream_SetSize
function.description: This function resizes a stream to a specified size. If the stream is already of the specified size, it does nothing. If the stream cannot be resized due to lack of memory, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the stream interface that is to be resized.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: This is the new size for the stream.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if the operation fails due to lack of memory.

function.name: stream_CopyTo
function.description: This function copies data from one stream to another. It reads data from the source stream, writes it to the destination stream, and keeps track of the total amount of data read and written.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The source stream from which data is read.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: The destination stream to which data is written.

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: The amount of data to copy from the source stream to the destination stream.

parameters.name: read_len
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the total amount of data read from the source stream.

parameters.name: written
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the total amount of data written to the destination stream.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: stream_Commit
function.description: This function commits changes to a stream object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to a stream object.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: This parameter specifies the flags for committing changes.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns S_OK indicating a successful operation.

function.name: stream_Revert
function.description: This function reverts a stream to its initial state.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface of the stream to be reverted.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status code of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: stream_LockRegion
function.description: This function attempts to lock a region in a stream, but always returns an error indicating the function is not valid.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStream interface

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies the byte offset for the beginning of the range

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Specifies, in bytes, the length of the range to be locked

parameters.name: lock_type
parameters.description: Specifies the restrictions on accessing the specified range

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function. Always returns STG_E_INVALIDFUNCTION indicating the function is not valid

function.name: stream_UnlockRegion
function.description: This function unlocks a region in a stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream interface

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset at which to start unlocking

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The length of the region to unlock

parameters.name: lock_type
parameters.description: The type of lock to unlock

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if the operation was successful

function.name: stream_Stat
function.description: This function initializes a STATSTG structure with stream data, sets the type to STGTY_STREAM and the size to the size of the stream handle.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IStream interface

parameters.name: pstatstg
parameters.description: Pointer to a STATSTG structure to be filled with stream data

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to control the stat operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if successful

function.name: stream_Clone
function.description: This function clones a stream and sets the position of the cloned stream to the same position as the original stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the original stream to be cloned.

parameters.name: ppstm
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer, which will point to the cloned stream after the function is executed.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is not enough memory to create the clone.

function.name: CreateStreamOnHGlobal
function.description: This function creates a stream object that uses an HGLOBAL memory handle to store the stream.

parameters.name: hGlobal
parameters.description: Handle to a global memory object. This is the memory block that the stream object will use.

parameters.name: delete_on_release
parameters.description: If TRUE, the function frees the hGlobal parameter when the IStream object is released.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to an IStream interface pointer. This parameter cannot be NULL. Receives the interface pointer to the new stream object.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: GetHGlobalFromStream
function.description: This function retrieves a global memory handle from a stream object.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: This is the input stream from which the global memory handle is retrieved.

parameters.name: phglobal
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the global memory handle that is retrieved from the stream.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, E_INVALIDARG if either of the input parameters is NULL, or if the stream does not have a valid hglobalstreamvtbl.
